title: West side jobs and the Ansonia with Perez
summary: He recalls the Chinese restaurant job and Madison Street, and the Ansonia with Perez, Teo, Cantrell and Frank Aime.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: And that first job done in the Chicago, the Chinese restroom, is that on sort of the west side?

I was over on the west side, yeah. I was over on, I think I was over on Madison. I was over on Madison, some left in there, Palina, Madison Palina. And we all played up there, Madison Palina, at the Sonia with myself, Emmanuel Perez, Teo, Lorenzo Teo, Cantrell, Frank Aime, and Dixieland, and the only Dixieland band was the other. The original five. There was in one corner and there was the other corner.
The Ansonia, yeah. There was one corner and there was the other corner.
You played with that band for a while then too, with Manuel?
